vol_rle_bbox — 3D rle_region op

• Data kinds: rle_region → primitive

• Call: import volregion; volregion.vol_rle_bbox(region) (or ops3d.get("vol_rle_bbox"))

Usage

Tight bounding box `(z0, y0, x0, z1, y1, x1)` (exclusive upper bounds)
